lines: Approximately 59% of the September 30, 2026 RPO balance is expected to be recognized as revenue within the following 12 months, and approximately 71% is expected to be recognized as revenue within the following 24 months.

desk.headline: Revenue up 21% to $4.5m, beat; loss of $0.13 a share wider than estimates, no financial outlook given
results: Revenue rose 21% to $4.5m as professional services and cloud access (QCaaS) grew, offsetting $1.5m less from system sales.
Gross margin fell to 52.9% from 71.4% because lower-margin services made up more of the mix.
Operating costs rose 84% to $55.9m on hiring, share pay and amortisation from the Quantum Circuits deal; the net loss was $48.2m.
The loss per share narrowed to $0.13 from $0.41 only because last year carried a $122m warrant charge.
Cash and securities stood at $503m; a deal with the US Commerce Department gives access to up to $100m of CHIPS Act funds, tied to milestones.

guidance.summary: D-Wave gave no revenue or profit guidance. It said about 59% of its $38.3m order backlog should turn into revenue within 12 months and about 71% within 24 months.

points: Management highlighted a triple-digit rise in year-to-date bookings and a sales pipeline it called robust, driven by system sales.
Q4 revenue depends on when a system is delivered to Florida Atlantic University.
Management expects all revenue lines to grow in 2027, with government business becoming much larger.
Talks are under way on orders for 17-qubit gate-model systems for 2027 delivery; a gate-model simulator beta has launched.
No CHIPS Act money has been received yet; payouts depend on milestones.
call.source: Investor update (Exhibit 99.2); call coverage: Earnings Whispers via Finviz, 10 Nov 2026

watch: Whether the Florida Atlantic University system is delivered and booked as Q4 revenue.
New bookings after a weak Q3 ($1.9m) and whether the backlog keeps shrinking.
Cash burn against the $503m balance and timing of CHIPS Act payments.

sources.title: D-Wave Beats On Revenue And EPS, But Fading Bookings, Shrinking RPO And Rising Burn Undercut The Quarter — Earnings Whispers via Finviz, 10 Nov 2026
